## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

This repository provides a lightweight Node.js library for retrieving GitHub repository and user details through the GitHub REST API. It offers functions like `githubApiGetProject` and `githubApiGetLogin` that accept path‑expression constants to return only the needed parts of the response, reducing bandwidth and simplifying downstream code. The library can operate in production mode, making real API calls, or in mock mode, returning static data structures for testing without network access. Deprecated helpers such as `getGithubTopics` are retained for backward compatibility but encourage migration to the newer, more flexible API. Developers can quickly integrate these utilities to display project topics, avatars, or other metadata in their applications, benefiting from built‑in logging and easy configuration.
